report: PERSIST-2c landed the PG/SQLite adapter seam (the S-BS-38 realization): a LITHRIM_DB_URL connection-factory + a Dialect (?/%s, TEXT/JSONB) + a tier:pro license-gated PostgresProvenanceStore (a parallel ProvenanceStore impl with the same versioned copy-on-write) + yoyo migrations in a [pg] extra, with run_eval routed through provenance_store_for so pointing the grade at Postgres is ONE env var. The OSS core stays stdlib-sqlite3 + offline (no DB driver imported at load — pinned), SQLite is the 100%-tested default, and the full suite is byte-identical to the pre-2c baseline (zero regressions, incl. the grade-path wiring). THE CAVEAT (honesty-is-the-moat): the PG impl is CONTRACT-SHAPED + SQLite-PROVEN but NOT CI-live-verified — it can't be run offline; the gated contract test (LITHRIM_DB_URL + pip install '.[pg]') is its proof against a real Postgres → S-BS-PERSIST-2C-PG-UNVERIFIED. Config-plane PG is a follow-on (S-BS-PERSIST-2C-CONFIG-TIER). HARD GATE — a fresh critic should re-run A1–A6 + the zero-regression diff + the acc4973 0-delta and audit the PG-caveat honesty.
